nuggets.text: James Franklin was a quarterback at East Stroudsburg and broke or tied 23 school records.
James Franklin's coaching stops include a stint with the NFL's Green Bay Packers.
The Hokies opened James Franklin's tenure by beating VMI 73-3, outgaining the Keydets 619 yards to 83.
Metallica's "Enter Sandman" has played as the Hokies take the field at Lane Stadium since 2000.
The Hokies blocked two punts against VMI, their first two-block game since 2017 against Pitt.
When Metallica played "Enter Sandman" at Lane Stadium in May 2025, seismic sensors registered it as a small earthquake.
Bud Foster made a battered metal lunch pail the symbol of the Hokies' blue-collar defense in the mid-1990s.
The modern HokieBird debuted in 1987 at the home opener against Clemson, arriving in a white limousine.
James Franklin tailgated at an Old Dominion game in Norfolk last fall, a year before coaching against the Monarchs.
